name: Budipine
summary: Budipine (brand name Parkinsan) is an antiparkinson agent marketed for the treatment of Parkinson's disease.

pharmacology.text: While its exact mechanism of action is not well characterized, it is believed to be an NMDA receptor antagonist, but also promoting the synthesis of dopamine. It is an hERG blocker and can produce long QT syndrome as a side effect.

uses.text: Budipine (brand name Parkinsan) is an antiparkinson agent marketed for the treatment of Parkinson's disease. Because it provides additional benefits relative to existing treatments, it probably does not precisely mimic the mechanism of an existing known treatment.

summaryZh: 叔丁哌苯（英語：Budipine，也譯為布地平）商品名Parkinsan，分子式C21H27N，是一種帕金森氏症治療藥物，其作用機制尚未解明。
summaryZhHans: 叔丁哌苯（英语：Budipine，也译为布地平）商品名Parkinsan，分子式C21H27N，是一种帕金森氏症治疗药物，其作用机制尚未解明。

sideEffects.en: It blocks the hERG potassium channel in the heart and can cause long QT syndrome, a dangerous disturbance of heart rhythm, so heart monitoring is needed. Other reported effects include dry mouth, confusion and dizziness.
sideEffects.zh: 它會阻斷心臟的 hERG 鉀離子通道，可能造成 QT 延長症候群，這是一種危險的心律異常，因此需要心臟監測。其他回報的反應包括口乾、混亂與頭暈。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会阻断心脏的 hERG 钾离子信道，可能造成 QT 延长症候群，这是一种危险的心律异常，因此需要心脏监测。其他回报的反应包括口干、混乱与头晕。

fact.en: It is used for Parkinson's disease and seems to work by more than one route, both blocking the NMDA receptor and encouraging the brain to make more dopamine.
fact.zh: 叔丁哌苯用於帕金森氏症，其作用似乎不只一條途徑：既阻斷 NMDA 受體，也促進大腦製造更多多巴胺。
fact.zhHans: 叔丁哌苯用于帕金森氏症，其作用似乎不只一条途径：既阻断 NMDA 受体，也促进大脑制造更多多巴胺。
